_comment: Named finetune protocols: training_params.finetune.protocol = <name> applies one entry (dotted keys, in order, like --set) after base_config merging; --set on the command line still wins over it. Frozen 2026-09-25 from the DEV-set grid configs/sweeps/tune_base_s1.json (BNCI2015001 MI, BNCI2014009 P300, never reported): the top config per cell, top-10 within 1.6 points. Don't retune these per backbone -- that would confound a backbone comparison. Head: the all-stamp head (stamp_power + signed_ab, spatial_k 8, dropout 0.3) in every protocol since 2026-10-02 (docs/reports/2026-10-02-head-ablation.md): every feature reads the stamps. The stronger head is stamp_power + latent_signed (pca), the protocol head 2026-10-01..02, better on MI few-shot (BNCI2014004 +3.5); set it with --set model_params.MeSAE.finetune.features=... The tuned split / LR / weight-decay / epoch values are unchanged. Earlier protocol heads: stamp_power (MI) or stamp_power + signed_ab (P300), spatial_k 2 / 8. Few-shot fit (2026-10-04): mi_fewshot / p300_fewshot fit the closed-form head (model/MeSAE/closed_form.py, no SGD: per-stamp CSP + shrinkage LDA for MI, stamp xDAWN covariances + tangent space + LR for P300), picked on DEV few-shot (+7.5 / +5.4 over the SGD head); their SGD keys stay for --set training_params.finetune.fit="sgd". Few-shot head (2026-10-05): both few-shot protocols fit closed_form branch 'structured' -- the all-stamp head's own factors (spatial filter x stamp weights x time course, same ranks) set in closed form, one head for every paradigm; picked on DEV few-shot over BNCI2015001 / BNCI2014009 / Kalunga2016 (SSVEP): mean +2.9 over the per-paradigm power / signed branches (MI +1.6, SSVEP +11.0, P300 -4.1). signed_time_rank 'full' (2026-10-06): the signed half keeps every patch; picked on the DEV mean over BNCI2015001 / BNCI2014009 / Kalunga2016 / Wang2016_dev (phase-locked SSVEP) by a rule set before the runs (rank 2 / 4 / 8 / full: 53.2 / 54.9 / 56.7 / 59.7).
_dataset_split_comment: Per-dataset split settings applied on top of any protocol, matching the EEG-FM-Compass code (github.com/Dingkun0817/EEG-FM-Benchmark, datasets/*/Preprocess_Dataset.py and its configs): BNCI2014004 uses session '3test' (index 3 in our caches, 160 trials/subject); BNCI2014008 few-shot calibrates on 5% of the session. train_fraction applies only to fewshot splits. Nakanishi2015 few-shot trains on 80% (Compass); its trials do not overlap, so runs set split.purge=0 over p300_fewshot's purge 5. Kalunga2016 (SSVEP DEV, 2026-10-05) mirrors Nakanishi2015: 80%, runs set split.purge=0. Wang2016_dev (phase-locked SSVEP DEV, 2026-10-06): 80%, purge 0, as Nakanishi2015.
